msg.astrofactory.research.nothing: No technology available (prerequisites unmet or all unlocked)
advancements.astrofactory.root.title: AstroFactory: The Automation Path
advancements.astrofactory.root.descripti:
Welcome! This mod brings Factorio-style automation into Minecraft.

Step one: craft an Iron Gear at a crafting table with 5 iron ingots in a U shape (1 on the top row, 1 on each side of the middle row, 1 on each side of the bottom row).

Iron Gears are the base part for every machine. Once done, the advancement tree keeps guiding you.
advancements.astrofactory.transport_belt:
Conveyor belts are the veins of your factory.

Recipe (crafting table):
  Row 1: Iron Ingot - empty - Iron Ingot
  Row 2: Iron Ingot - Redstone - Iron Ingot
Yields 3 belts.

Placement tips:
- Facing follows your view direction
- Items slide continuously along the belt, not tile by tile
- Chain belts end to end to extend
- Point the belt end into a chest to auto-insert
advancements.astrofactory.burner_inserte:
Belts cannot hand items to each other directly; use a robotic arm.

Recipe (crafting table):
  Row 1: Iron Gear - Piston - Iron Gear
  Row 2: empty - Copper Coil - empty

How it works:
- Takes from its BACK face, inserts into its FRONT face
- Front face points where you look when placing
- Moves 1 item every 0.5 s
- If the target is full it holds the item and retries; nothing is lost

Typical use: belt -> robotic arm -> machine input
advancements.astrofactory.burner_miner.d:
No ore veins needed; the burner_miner produces ore on its own.

Recipe (crafting table):
  Row 1: Iron Ingot - Iron Ingot - Iron Ingot
  Row 2: Iron Gear - Diamond Pickaxe - Iron Gear
  Row 3: Iron Ingot - Iron Ingot - Iron Ingot

How it works:
- Produces 1 raw ore every 2 s (iron/copper/gold)
- Outputs from its FRONT face
- Infinite, never depletes

Suggested: burner_miner front -> transport_belt -> stone_furnace
Turns raw ore from the burner_miner into ingots.

Recipe (crafting table):
  Row 1: Bricks - Bricks - Bricks
  Row 2: Bricks - Furnace - Bricks
  Row 3: Bricks - Iron Gear - Bricks

How it works:
- Input slot takes raw ore, output slot gives ingots
- Processes 1 item every 3 s
- Supports: raw iron->iron, raw copper->copper, raw gold->gold, cobblestone->stone, sand->glass
- Only accepts items that have a recipe

Tip: right-click to open the GUI and insert by hand, or feed it with a robotic arm.
advancements.astrofactory.assembler.desc:
The assembler combines multiple parts into a finished product.

Recipe (crafting table):
  Row 1: Iron Ingot - Iron Gear - Iron Ingot
  Row 2: Iron Gear - Crafter - Iron Gear
  Row 3: Iron Ingot - Copper Coil - Iron Ingot

How it works:
- Has a 9-slot input grid; arrange items in a pattern
- Current recipe (circuit board):
    gear - coil - gear
    empty - coil - empty
    empty - empty - empty
- Produces once every 1.5 s
- Only consumes the slots the recipe needs; extras stay put

Tip: robotic arms fill the grid in slot order, so mind the order when laying out patterns.
advancements.astrofactory.electronic_cir:
Circuit boards are the only research pack in this mod; only they advance the tech tree.

Two ways to get them:
1. Assembler (recommended):
     gear - coil - gear
     empty - coil - empty
     empty - empty - empty
2. Hand crafting at a table:
     gear - coil - gear
     empty - coil - empty
     redstone - redstone - redstone

The hand recipe costs extra redstone so you can bootstrap before building an assembler.

Next step after getting a board: the research table.
advancements.astrofactory.lab.title: Research Table: Unlock the Tech Tree
advancements.astrofactory.lab.descriptio:
The research table is the entry point to the tech tree.

Recipe (crafting table):
  Row 1: Planks - Book - Planks
  Row 2: Iron Gear - Lapis Lazuli - Iron Gear
  Row 3: Planks - Planks - Planks

Usage:
- Right-click to open the GUI
- Put circuit boards into the input slot and press Contribute
- Each board gives 1 research point
- Enough points unlock the technology

Tech order (with prerequisites):
  Automation I (10) -> Mining I (20) / Assembly I (20)
  Assembly I -> Research I (50)
  Mining I + Assembly I -> Logistics I (50)

Unlocking Logistics I lets you build fast transport_belt belts.
advancements.astrofactory.fast_transport:
The key to speeding up a line.

Recipe (shapeless):
  Conveyor x2 + Iron Gear x1 -> Fast Conveyor x2

Features:
- Twice the belt speed of a normal transport_belt
- Used exactly like a normal transport_belt
- Best on main lines; keep normal belts on branches to save materials

You now know the full chain:
mining -> transport -> smelting -> crafting -> assembling -> research

Next: scale it into a real factory.
msg.astrofactory.guide.step1: 1. Craft an Iron Gear (5 iron ingots in a U) - the base part for all machines
msg.astrofactory.guide.step2: 2. Craft transport_belts (iron + redstone); facing follows your view, belt end into a chest auto-inserts
msg.astrofactory.guide.step3: 3. Craft a robotic arm (gears + piston + coil): takes from back, inserts at front
msg.astrofactory.guide.step4: 4. Craft a burner_miner (iron + gears + diamond pickaxe); 1 ore per 2 s from its front face
msg.astrofactory.guide.step5: 5. Craft a stone_furnace (bricks + furnace + gear); ore to ingot, 1 per 3 s
msg.astrofactory.guide.step8: 8. Produce circuit boards in the assembler (gear-coil-gear / empty-coil-empty / empty-empty-empty)
msg.astrofactory.guide.step9: 9. Craft a research table (planks + book + gears + lapis); contribute boards to unlock tech
msg.astrofactory.guide.step10: 10. After Logistics I, craft fast transport_belts (transport_belt x2 + gear) for double belt speed
